name: jai-vscode-dev
description: Syntax highlighting, a nested outline, workspace symbol search, and structure-aware Smart Select for the Jai programming language.

jai.outline.showGlobalProcedures.markdownDescription: Outline: show file-scope procedures (`name :: (...)` or an anonymous procedure assigned to a file-scope name). Hiding a symbol also hides its subtree. These `jai.outline.*` settings filter the symbols the extension returns — more precisely than the built-in `outline.show*` settings — and therefore also affect breadcrumbs, Go to Symbol and Sticky Scroll.

jai.outline.showNonGlobalProcedures.markdownDescription: Outline: show procedures outside file scope, including procedures inside another procedure, a `#run` block, or a type/interface body.

jai.outline.showStructs.markdownDescription: Outline: show structs and unions, including anonymous ones assigned to a name.

jai.outline.showEnums.markdownDescription: Outline: show enums and enum_flags, including anonymous ones assigned to a name.

jai.outline.showConstants.markdownDescription: Outline: show non-global constants (`name :: value` inside procedures, `#run` blocks, or types). File-scope constants are controlled by `#jai.outline.showGlobalConstants#`.

jai.outline.showGlobalConstants.markdownDescription: Outline: show file-scope constants (`name :: value`). This is separate from `#jai.outline.showConstants#`, which controls constants in non-global scopes.

jai.outline.showGlobalVariables.markdownDescription: Outline: show variables declared outside any procedure/type (file-scope globals).

jai.outline.showLocalVariables.markdownDescription: Outline: show local variables declared inside procedures and `#run` blocks. Hidden by default to reduce outline noise; unlike `outline.showVariables`, this does not control globals, parameters, or loop variables — toggle those separately.

jai.outline.showParameters.markdownDescription: Outline: show procedure/struct parameters. Polymorphic `$T` and `T: Type` parameters are controlled by `#jai.outline.showTypeParameters#`.

jai.outline.showTypeParameters.markdownDescription: Outline: show polymorphic type parameters (`$T`, `T: Type`).

jai.workspaceSymbols.enabled.markdownDescription: Workspace symbols (`Ctrl+T`): enable the workspace-wide symbol index. The index is built lazily on the first workspace-symbol request — nothing is scanned at startup — and kept up to date incrementally as files change.

jai.workspaceSymbols.maxWorkers.markdownDescription: Workspace symbols: maximum worker threads used to tokenize/outline files while indexing. `0` means automatic (one less than the CPU count, capped at 8). If workers cannot start, indexing falls back to the main thread.

jai.workspaceSymbols.maxFileSizeKiB.markdownDescription: Workspace symbols: files larger than this are skipped by the workspace index (they still work normally in the editor and document outline). `0` means **unlimited** — no file is skipped because of its size.

jai.workspaceSymbols.exclude.markdownDescription: Workspace symbols: glob patterns excluded from the workspace index. Empty by default — no folders (including `node_modules`, `.git`, or build output) are excluded unless you add patterns here. Changing this rebuilds the index lazily on the next workspace-symbol request.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node ./test/outline.check.js && node ./test/selection.check.js && node ./test/workspace.check.js
